name: Daughter Maker
source:
Suddenly main character's boss and lover Michiko dies from overwork. Protagonist decides to take care of Michiko's only daughter Mio. With time his attraction to Mio overgrows the one that foster father should have.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的老板兼恋人美智子突然因过度劳累而去世。主角决定照顾美智子唯一的女儿澪。随着时间的推移，他对澪的吸引力超过了养父应有的吸引力。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
